skip.reset: The page holds imported tables, not a view to reset: "Remove this table" removes one, and "Return to the inferred reading" undoes a column's changes. The example and the count of highlights in the URL are the only view state, which back-forward, url-state and the charts check cover.
skip.json-round-trip: Imported data never leaves the page as a view file. A project is saved in the export package and reopened with its source hashes checked; the export package check in full.test.mjs covers it.
